symptoms: Dark brown circular spots with distinctive concentric rings
Yellow halo around mature spots on lower older foliage
Dry, leathery dark brown spots on potato tuber skins
risk_factors: Warm days with high humidity and alternating dry periods
Nitrogen deficiency or aging plant tissue
prevention: Maintain balanced crop nutrition (especially nitrogen and potassium)
Avoid overhead irrigation in late afternoon
recommended_actions: Apply protectant fungicides (chlorothalonil/mancozeb) upon early symptom detection
